findings.entity: second white coffee mug held by waitress
findings.description: Waitress holds a second white mug beside the man's mug (man gripping his own mug). As she pushes it toward his, the two mugs overlap and fuse into a single mug held by both hands (~01:12.5-01:13). From 01:13 onward only one mug exists; the second mug is never set down, taken back, or shown elsewhere. It vanishes by merging into the other.

Under the man's left hand at 01:38 the money is a thin, flat bill (one or two layers). When the hand lifts at ~01:39 it has become a fanned stack of about three notes with the top note curled upward. No extra bills are visibly added: the right hand only brushes the edge. This looks like an unexplained change in note count or form, though occlusion by the fingers might be hiding it.
